items.title: Pushing a normalized dualizing complex forward along a finite local map stays normalized
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pushforward of a normalized dualizing complex along a finite local map of Noetherian local rings is a normalized dualizing complex for the target (author lemma at source lines 3135-3142, label lemma-normalized-finite). The proof (source lines 3144-3157) gets the dualizing property from the finite-pushforward statement, rewrites the internal hom from the residue field through the adjunction and uses that the target residue field is a finite sum of copies of the source residue field to conclude normalization (proof lines 3144-3156). The adjunction computation is the substance. H3.
